related.title: NIST 表面阱：運動加熱率與等待時間
related.titleEn: NIST surface trap: motional heating rate and wait time
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付邊帶積分表、非線性反算曲線及有效域標記。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver integrated sidebands, nonlinear inversion curves and validity-domain markers. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『NIST 表面阱：運動加熱率與等待時間』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付等待—聲子圖、斜率驗證及冷卻插入位置。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'NIST surface trap: motional heating rate and wait time', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver wait/phonon plots, slope verification and recooling insertion points.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：熱分布且弱探測時紅藍邊帶比R=Ired/Iblue=n̄/(n̄+1)，所以n̄=R/(1−R)。 使用合成積分紅邊帶0.2、藍邊帶1.0，R=0.2；先不加入飽和效應。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.2/(1-0.2)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：反算R=n̄/(n̄+1)還原兩比例；把R=1列為發散界線，R>1不是有效熱平衡解。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：短時間常數加熱代理n̄(t)=n̄0+ṉt；不包括重新冷卻、模式耦合或非線性飽和。 使用教學n̄0=0.05、ṉ=10聲子/s、等待20 ms。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.05+10*0.020，另開一欄執行獨立核對：從5與20 ms兩點斜率反算10聲子/s；時間必須先換成秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For a thermal distribution under weak probing, red/blue ratio R=n̄/(n̄+1), hence n̄=R/(1−R). Use Synthetic integrated red sideband0.2 and blue1.0 give R=0.2; saturation is initially excluded. Evaluate nominal expression 0.2/(1-0.2) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Invert R=n̄/(n̄+1) for both cases; R=1 is divergent and R>1 is not a valid thermal solution.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Short-time constant-heating proxy n̄(t)=n̄0+ṉt excludes recooling, mode coupling and nonlinear saturation. Use Teaching n̄0=0.05, heating rate10 phonons/s and wait20 ms. Evaluate nominal expression 0.05+10*0.020 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Recover10 phonons/s from the5 and20 ms slope; convert time to seconds first.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Atom Computing arrays: stochastic loading and full-occupancy probability

related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Atom Computing arrays: stochastic loading and full-occupancy probability', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver mean/full-occupancy metrics, log verification and correlation tests.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：熱分布且弱探測時紅藍邊帶比R=Ired/Iblue=n̄/(n̄+1)，所以n̄=R/(1−R)。 使用合成積分紅邊帶0.2、藍邊帶1.0，R=0.2；先不加入飽和效應。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.2/(1-0.2)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：反算R=n̄/(n̄+1)還原兩比例；把R=1列為發散界線，R>1不是有效熱平衡解。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：獨立載入、每格成功p時N格滿載概率P=p^N；平均Np與滿載概率是不同量。 使用教學N=20、單格p=0.5；不含重排、重試或相關載入。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.5**20，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以log(P)=Nlog(p)交叉檢查；再列N=1極限，避免把0.9誤報成全陣列成功率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For a thermal distribution under weak probing, red/blue ratio R=n̄/(n̄+1), hence n̄=R/(1−R). Use Synthetic integrated red sideband0.2 and blue1.0 give R=0.2; saturation is initially excluded. Evaluate nominal expression 0.2/(1-0.2) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Invert R=n̄/(n̄+1) for both cases; R=1 is divergent and R>1 is not a valid thermal solution.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: With independent per-site loading p, full occupancy of N sites is P=p^N; mean Np is a different quantity. Use Teaching N=20 and p=0.5 per site; exclude rearrangement, retries and correlated loading. Evaluate nominal expression 0.5**20 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Cross-check log(P)=Nlog(p) and the N=1 limit; do not report0.9 as array-level success.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
